name: ViewTemplate
summary: Template that represents a view subcomponent of an [ItemTemplate](api:ItemTemplate).
description: See [Titanium.UI.ListItem](api:Titanium.UI.ListItem) for examples of using an item template.

properties.name: bindId
properties.summary: View's ID (or set of IDs) used for data binding. This value must be unique.

properties.name: childTemplates
properties.summary: Contains an array of subview templates to be added (in order) as children to this view.

properties.name: events
properties.summary: Contains key-value pairs of view events and their listeners that are applied to this view component.
properties.description: Array values are considered as multiple event listeners for that event.

properties.name: properties
properties.summary: Contains key-value pairs of view properties and their values that are applied to this view component.

properties.name: type
properties.description:
Only the following view classes are supported:

  * [Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator](api:Titanium.UI.ActivityIndicator)
  * [Titanium.UI.Button](api:Titanium.UI.Button)
  * [Titanium.UI.ButtonBar](api:Titanium.UI.ButtonBar)
  * [Titanium.UI.ImageView](api:Titanium.UI.ImageView)
  * [Titanium.UI.Label](api:Titanium.UI.Label)
  * [Titanium.UI.MaskedImage](api:Titanium.UI.MaskedImage)
  * [Titanium.UI.ProgressBar](api:Titanium.UI.ProgressBar)
  * [Titanium.UI.Picker](api:Titanium.UI.Picker)
  * [Titanium.UI.ScrollableView](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollableView)
  * [Titanium.UI.Slider](api:Titanium.UI.Slider)
  * [Titanium.UI.Switch](api:Titanium.UI.Switch)
  * [Titanium.UI.TextArea](api:Titanium.UI.TextArea)
  * [Titanium.UI.TextField](api:Titanium.UI.TextField)
  * [Titanium.UI.iOS.BlurView](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.BlurView)
  * [Titanium.UI.iOS.LivePhotoView](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.LivePhotoView)
  * [Titanium.UI.iOS.Stepper](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.Stepper)
  * [Titanium.UI.iOS.TabbedBar](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.TabbedBar)
